notes: Window sticker small of the partner package, shown as a mock-up on the slide 'Partner pakket'. REAL SIZE IS A PROPOSAL: the slide has no dimensions; the grey body measures 48.5 x 16.4 mm at the slide scale 0.358 (poster 210 mm = 75.3 mm), so 135.5 x 45.8 mm real, proposed 136 x 46 mm (trim, 3 mm bleed). Layout: colour beeldmerk (left) on a light grey base, two stacked pills: the upper one holds 'Parkeer slim bij', the lower one is white with the garage symbol and 'Hofplein'. Body: the light grey base is ONE flat shape, the beeldmerk bubble and the two pills merged (no blurred edge); in the file it sits in a 30 percent transparency group (#CCCCCE), which renders as #F0F0F0 and is read as the sticker body, not as a shadow (owner to confirm; if the sticker is transparent or white instead, only the body colour changes). The template draws the body flat in #F0F0F0 (no token, observed) and 3 mm bleed as the outline moved outward. Library: py-atom-logo-beeldmerk-color (same height as the source, centred; the mock-up beeldmerk is 3 percent wider than the library shape, so it was stretched in the slide: library proportions kept) and py-atom-symbol-p-garage-outline (compared: same drawing, 13.4 mm wide). The white pill is a construction (rounded rectangle, 87.2 x 17.2 mm); no library pill matches (py-comp-pill-destination has a disc and a bold label, py-comp-lockup-location-garage has a two line bold name and other spacing), so no new element. Text: 'Parkeer slim bij' is outlined in the source; fitted by overlay it is Ubuntu Medium (not bold: Bold at the same width is 0.5 mm too low), 12.09 mm, centred in the pill; 'Hofplein' is live in the source (Ubuntu Medium 4.2 mm = 11.7 mm real). Colours: the slide blue #192AA2 and cyan #0AD3E6 are drift, the template uses #1A3580 and #32B9CD (inside the library beeldmerk). Cut contour: proposal, no contour in the mock-up; it follows the sticker outline 0.2 mm inside the trim, 1 pt ThruCut. Variables: line-1 (first line), location-name.
